[EN] Mission Orders

We can't let Atel Akaad and their allies tighten their hold on Amena Quatla.

Take down {@LinkCreature:57#1#sikandari stalwarts}, {@LinkCreature:57#5#geilrik hellhounds}, Lokian {@LinkCreature:57#13#bloodchargers}, {@LinkCreature:57#16#bloodmaguses}, {@LinkCreature:57#26#bloodspillers}, and {@LinkCreature:57#21#bloodshapers}, and {@LinkCreature:57#23#eldritch vanquishers}.

Report to Emya in Dragonfall when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

No podemos dejar que Atel Akaad y sus aliados endurezcan su control sobre Amena Quatla.

Derrota a los {@LinkCreature:57#1#sikandari stalwarts}, {@LinkCreature:57#5#geilrik hellhounds}, Lokian {@LinkCreature:57#13#bloodchargers}, {@LinkCreature:57#16#bloogmaguses}, {@LinkCreature:57#26#bloodspillers}, y {@LinkCreature:57#21#bloodshapers}, y {@LinkCreature:57#23#eldritch vanquishers}.

Preséntate ante Emya en Dragonfall cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation! Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] ¡Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación! ¡Tu gremio es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
